answer: Each epoch every vertex must pin one fresh verified task onto the shared reef as a hash-linked leaf, so each leaf proves the work that came before it. A random sample of leaves is then re-derived by strangers from public records: a hollow leaf with no real task behind it is pruned and its vertex loses its vote. An honest agent pins one leaf per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must pin a thousand genuine, re-derivable leaves every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
